title: First-hand Report from Ps.Bipin Bihari Naik
imageAlt: Pastor Bipin Bihari Naik and family
bodyHtml:
Dear Friends, Greetings.

As I mentioned in my previous newsletter, I have already shared the story of Ps. Bipin Bihari Naik, the Persecuted Pastor, here is the first hand report from him, the brutal way they dealt with him, the humiliation in front of his teenage daughters, the threat to his life, the indirect denial of Police help, and even after they arrived, they became spectators of the whole thing, so walk with with me through this email, as I am going to unfold the pain of this humble heart.

Family

Pastor. Bipin Bihari Naik - 35 years.

Spouse: Mrs. Vandana Naik - 34 years.

Two Daughters: Oldest: Bathsebha 14 years - 8th Grade

Youngest: Belisima 11 years - 6th Grade

Village: Kondarasinga Village, Dhenkaan District, State of Odisha.

Seminary: Attended 3 years of seminary Training.

Residence: Rented Home

Active in Ministry: 15 Years.

The Black Day: On 04th Jan 2026, Ps. Bipin, along with his family, attended the Church service, and he had just finished preaching. There were around 40 people who attended that Sunday, as that was also the Communion Sunday, which was the big gathering compared to the normal Sundays, Pastor Bipin just finished his random preaching on the day from Matt 10:28 And be not afraid of them that kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell. Then he knelt at the table to break the bread and pour the wine.

Aggressive Mob with Slogans: There were over a hundred people with logs, saffron flags, and saffron-colored powder rammed into our church with aggressive slogans, creating panic and threatening everyone not to take photos or videos, then they tied his hands by surrounding him.

The Holy Cup desecration: They were shouting all the humiliating words, abusing the women and children present there. They took the wine cup, spilled the wine on the floor, filled it with cow dung water, and forced him to drink.

The Parade: They brought a garland of sandals wrapped around his neck and paraded him through the streets of the village, thrashing him, beating him from behind, demanding that he deny Jesus and repeat their slogans, which hail their deity.

The Drama at the Police Station / Mocking Behavior: We all know that when the public feels unsafe, they call the police for protection. Ps. Bipin's wife, Mrs.Vandhana Naik, rushed to the police station along with her daughters, asking desperately for immediate intervention to save her husband's life and give them protection.

It's not Instant Maggie: The Police were not interested in listening to what she is for, at least, no vehicle is available to come to your help at the moment, and don't expect that we will come to protect you, and it is not instant Maggie, that we can go with you instant there is no transportation available at the moment they mocked her.

Protectors became Spectators: By the time the police arrived, over 300 people from their gang were gathered there, parading him through the village, taking him to the village temple, smearing saffron on his face, and demanding that he give slogans that would bring glory to their deity. Once again, even at the weakest point of the moment, by then they had beaten him all over, and he was almost to the point of fainting, and the Police were watching like they were passersby.

Vision Blurry but Seen Christ: It was by afternoon, 2 pm, they did not know how to bring this to an end, one after another leaving slowly, thinking he was going to die, and he was dehydrated, fainted, vision was blurry, but he could see Jesus with his wounded hands at that moment, his wife and other pastors came to take him to the hospital to get treatment.

Future Plan: I asked Ps. Bipin (as he has now taken refuge with Ps. Sridahr, who is 70 miles away from the incident), what are his plans for the future? He said he is eager to go back and restart the church over there, and my next question is what if it is a life threat to you, Ps. Bipin said it would be an honor for me to die in serving Him.

Sowers in Action: Indeed, to walk alongside the persecuted is the heart of the Sowers; infact it was a challenging train trip of 48 hours round trip to reach him, but when we took his family to a fancy dinner, the whole family was in tears; they said after the incident they lost appetite never ate anything to their content, but now they feel unworthy to be seated at the table in a posh hotel, but we told them they deserve it and it is from the Lord and from the Sowers Partners. They dined heartily. Sowers also left them some financial aid to cover the family's needs.

Dear Friends and Partners of Sowers, You are the Reason.
